original_wording: Configure an existing AI agent to support a real open-source workflow, test the configuration on historical cases, and justify your design decisions. Both the configuration and its justification will be assessed.
required_implementation_or_evidence: An existing agent, real workflow, historical evaluation and reasoned design.
justification: An existing agent, real workflow, historical evaluation and reasoned design.

original_wording: Choose a workflow in an open-source project, such as: issue triage; first-pass PR review; CI-failure analysis; duplicate detection; changelog drafting
required_implementation_or_evidence: Choose one appropriate workflow; the examples are alternatives.
evidence: DESIGN.md:1–4; README.md:3–6; 25 inputs name electron/electron source issues.
justification: Electron first-pass issue triage is one listed choice. No requirement to implement all five examples.

original_wording: Explain why an AI agent is appropriate for this workflow rather than conventional automation.
required_implementation_or_evidence: Explain the judgement boundary and compare with deterministic checks.
justification: Semantic component/reproduction/similarity decisions are distinguished from scripted validation. The baseline is actually evaluated; newer fallback does not beat its weighted cost.
grading_risk: Effectiveness is not conclusively demonstrated, but the assignment asks for a justification, not a mandatory baseline victory.
outstanding_work: Retain the negative baseline result; do not equate model appropriateness with demonstrated superiority.

original_wording: Use repository data to establish the need for automation (e.g., time to first issue response, number of PRs awaiting review).
required_implementation_or_evidence: A repository-derived workload or latency measure.
evidence: DESIGN.md:8–15; evals/need/raw/issues/; evals/need/issues_table.csv; evals/need/issue_metrics.json; evals/need/extra_metrics.json; reproduction-results.json
justification: Raw saved data reproduces both metric JSON files exactly: 193 issues, 144 eligible outside reports, 18.7h median first human action among 135 observed responses.

original_wording: State what you measured, over which period, and the limitations of the metric.
required_implementation_or_evidence: Name the quantities, observation window and limitations.
justification: July–September 2026, fetched 23 October; gist proxy, request detection, censoring and present-day author association limitations are stated.

original_wording: Students may choose the same project and workflow, but must develop and evaluate their configurations independently.

justification: Substantial local development and AI-assisted evaluation provenance exists; it cannot prove independence from other students. “Independent subagent” is a different claim.
grading_risk: Human attestation remains necessary; there is no evidence here of a violation.
outstanding_work: Student confirms independent development/evaluation and accurately credits any external assistance.
